items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XII, List of Answers on Terminology 77:1
items.html:
(to the question) Klalut [inclusion]
At the time when a measure of coarseness corrected in the fitting screen has already entered within the Partzuf, except that it is still lacking a coupling upon it, for some reason, it is discerned that the Mochin are completed in it from the phase of its inclusion, for all its corrections have already been completed, and it lacks only a coupling. (Part 1, Page 219, Item 238).
